clue.text: Despicable women gagged

parts.note: to gag is to heave as if about to vomit, i.e. retched

explanation.surface: A sneering remark about some unpleasant women who were silenced.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Gagged' suggests being silenced, but here it means heaving.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone wretched in this sense is contemptible or vile, a synonym of despicable.

clue.text: Intense anger surrounding new series

indicators.note: going round, so the anger word encloses the new letter

parts.note: rage is intense anger

explanation.surface: Fury erupting around a new television series.
explanation.definitionFit: A range is a set or line of similar things, such as a product series.

clue.text: Wrote about game, a fixture between two London boroughs

definitions.text: a fixture between two London boroughs

indicators.note: turned about, so the letters of wrote are put in a different order

parts.note: bridge is a card game

explanation.surface: A sports report on a fixture played between two London boroughs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fixture' suggests a sports match; it is a fixed structure.
explanation.definitionFit: Tower Bridge spans the Thames, linking the boroughs of Tower Hamlets and Southwark.

clue.text: Coins and banknotes in strong bag brought over here, initially

parts.note: hard means strong or tough

indicators.note: turned over in a down clue, so the bag word is read backwards

parts.note: a sac is a bag-like pouch

indicators.note: at the start, so only the opening letter of here is taken

explanation.surface: Bringing a bag of money here.
explanation.definitionFit: Hard cash is money in physical form rather than cheques or credit.

clue.text: All those in London embassies, say, do cramp politics, unfortunately

definitions.text: All those in London embassies, say

indicators.note: things gone badly wrong, so the letters of do cramp politics are put into disorder

explanation.surface: A complaint that foreign envoys in London hamper politics.
explanation.definitionFit: The diplomats accredited to a country, ambassadors and staff, form a recognised body.

clue.text: Iced drink female, Missy Elliott, say, endlessly required

indicators.note: without its end means the final letter of the word for her trade is dropped

parts.note: Missy Elliott is an American hip-hop artist, an example of a rapper

explanation.surface: A drinks order: an iced drink wanted by a female rap star.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endlessly' takes the last R from RAPPER, leaving RAPPE.
explanation.definitionFit: A frappé is a drink served chilled or poured over shaved ice, such as iced coffee.

clue.text: Perfect surface texture

definitions.meaning: as a verb, to perfect is to complete or put the final touches to
the final coating or polish on wood, paint or fabric

explanation.surface: A description of a flawless surface texture.
explanation.definitionFit: Finishing a job perfects it, and a varnished or polished coat is its outer texture.

clue.text: Wood, when hard

parts.note: as means when, as in 'as he arrived'
H is the pencil abbreviation for hard

explanation.surface: A note that timber is good when it is hard.
explanation.definitionFit: Ash is a tree whose tough pale timber is used for tool handles.

clue.text: In favour of writer exposing outlaw

parts.note: pro means for, in favour of
a scribe is a writer or copyist

explanation.surface: Someone backing a writer who exposes a criminal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'outlaw' looks like a noun but is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To proscribe something is to forbid or ban it by law.

clue.text: Warns suspect in possession of Ecstasy for a quick fix?

indicators.note: the shuffled letters hold the drug letter, so it goes inside them
suspect as an adjective means dubious, so the letters of warns are not to be trusted in their order

parts.note: E is the usual abbreviation for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: A police warning about a suspect caught with ecstasy, perhaps seeking a quick fix.
explanation.walkthrough: 'suspect' turns WARNS into ANSWR, and 'in possession of' puts E inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Solving a problem gives you its solution, so a quick fix is, playfully, a reply that settles the matter.

clue.text: Page with two articles on Roman temple

parts.note: the indefinite article an and the definite article the

explanation.surface: A text with a page of articles on a temple in Rome.
explanation.definitionFit: The Pantheon in Rome is an ancient domed building built as a shrine to all the gods.

clue.text: Endless courage may result in try

indicators.note: without an end means the last letter of the courage word is removed

parts.note: heart means courage, as in 'take heart'

explanation.surface: A motivational line: unending courage may lead to a rugby try.
explanation.walkthrough: 'try' looks like a rugby score or an attempt, but it is the legal sense.
explanation.definitionFit: A judge tries a case in court, which is to hear it and rule on it.

clue.text: Bad-tempered type to go over plot

parts.note: to cross something is to go over it
a plot of land is a patch

explanation.surface: A grumpy person stomping across a garden plot.
explanation.definitionFit: A crosspatch is an old informal name for a grumpy, irritable person.

clue.text: Suitable lift

definitions.meaning: fitting or right for the occasion
to lift is informally to steal, to take for oneself

explanation.definitionFit: As an adjective it means fitting; as a verb it means to take without permission.

clue.text: Daily, one's mother makes personal appeal

parts.note: a daily is a cleaning woman who comes every day, also called a char (British)
one is I, so one's is I'S
ma is an informal word for mother

explanation.surface: A cleaner whose mother has great personal appeal.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'daily' or 'char' is British for a charwoman, a domestic cleaner.
explanation.definitionFit: Charisma is the compelling charm that draws people to someone.

clue.text: Film a large individual below apartment?

indicators.note: in a down clue the apartment word sits on top of the other three pieces

parts.note: an apartment is an example of a home, hence the question mark
L is the standard abbreviation for large, as in clothing sizes
one means a single individual

explanation.surface: A large person living below someone's flat.
explanation.walkthrough: The 1990 film is about a boy left behind when his family flies off for Christmas.
explanation.definitionFit: Home Alone is a well-known Hollywood family comedy movie from 1990.

clue.text: Duo's quiet tune

parts.note: P is piano, the musical direction for quiet
an air is a melody or tune

explanation.surface: A musical double act and their soft tune.
explanation.definitionFit: A duo is two together, a couple or twosome.

clue.text: Father rises with very little desire to eat

indicators.note: goes upward in a down clue, so the father word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: pa is an informal word for father
petite means small or dainty

explanation.surface: A dad getting up with hardly any hunger.
explanation.definitionFit: Appetite is the natural craving for food.

clue.text: Surrounded by papers after American married

indicators.note: the papers piece comes after the other two in the answer

parts.note: ID, identity documents, are one's papers

explanation.surface: Someone buried in paperwork after marrying an American.
explanation.definitionFit: Amid is a preposition meaning in the middle of, encircled by.

clue.text: Unsuitable, if I'm right

parts.note: taken as written, apostrophe dropped
proper means right or correct

explanation.surface: Someone protesting that a thing is wrong only if they are right.
explanation.definitionFit: Improper describes conduct that is not fitting or appropriate.

clue.text: Number collecting wood for burning

indicators.note: gathering in, so the number word holds the wood inside it

parts.note: one is a number
fir is a type of tree and its timber

explanation.surface: Several people gathering wood to burn.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Number' looks like a quantity of people, but it is a numeral.
explanation.definitionFit: Something on fire is alight, ablaze.

clue.text: Place of worship excited a celebrant

indicators.note: agitated or stirred up, so the letters of a celebrant are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: An excited priest celebrating in a place of worship.
explanation.definitionFit: A tabernacle is a sacred tent or a nonconformist meeting house used for religious services.

clue.text: Widespread fire put out

indicators.note: disturbed or disordered, so the letters of fire are rearranged

explanation.surface: A widespread blaze is finally extinguished.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put out' looks like extinguishing, but signals the letters disordered.
explanation.definitionFit: Something rife is common and prevalent, found everywhere.

clue.text: Stick carried by fine old hobbit

indicators.note: held within, so the stick word goes between the other two letters

parts.note: F is the pencil abbreviation for fine
a rod is a stick

explanation.surface: An old hobbit carrying a fine walking stick.
explanation.definitionFit: Frodo Baggins is the hobbit who carries the One Ring in Tolkien's The Lord of the Rings.

clue.text: Messenger saving time for royal attendant

indicators.note: keeping safe, so the messenger word holds the time letter inside

parts.note: a courier carries messages and parcels

explanation.surface: A messenger preserving time for a member of the royal household.
explanation.definitionFit: A courtier is someone in attendance at a monarch's court.

clue.text: Visually embarrassed about daughter

parts.note: re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: A parent clearly embarrassed about their daughter.
explanation.definitionFit: A blushing face shows embarrassment by its colour, so the word describes visible shame.

clue.text: One after the other having an argument

definitions.meaning: quarrelling, from row meaning a noisy dispute

explanation.surface: Arguing people speaking one after another.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means consecutively, and with row as a quarrel it also means engaged in a dispute.

clue.text: The French behind want to wind up

indicators.note: the French article is placed after the want word

parts.note: to want is to need
le is a French word for the

explanation.surface: A French rear end wanting to tease someone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wind up' is British slang for tease or provoke.
explanation.definitionFit: To needle someone is to irritate or provoke them, the same as winding them up.

clue.text: Son having to kneel shuffling set of bones

indicators.note: moving around clumsily, so the letters of to kneel are rearranged

explanation.surface: A son forced to kneel, shuffling a collection of bones.
explanation.definitionFit: A skeleton is the full framework of bones of a body.
